briefing.headline: Nvidia faces its biggest earnings test yet after CEO Jensen Huang's resignation, while new US chip curbs hit AI and chip stocks across Asia.

points.text: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO, and investors have been weighing the fallout. Nvidia shares fell for several days before earnings.
points.label: reported

points.text: The US Commerce Department is tightening export controls on AI chips, including overseas AI compute leasing. Chip stocks fell in the US and Asia.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia warned chip buyers of legal risks tied to China AI access. US agencies said investigations into Nvidia partner Megaspeed began in 2024.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia reports earnings after the US close on Tuesday, about 1:20am Wednesday in Dubai. Markets are waiting for the result.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Anthropic's IPO is expected to price on Wednesday. Altimeter Capital says it is 10 to 20 times oversubscribed and is investing $5 billion.
